## Who Pro is for

- Multi-location businesses with recurring deadlines
- Teams managing renewals across entities and locations
- Operations teams replacing spreadsheet-based deadline tracking
- Businesses needing one workspace for documents, ownership, and review

## What you can track on Pro

- License renewals
- Permit renewals
- Business registrations
- Annual reports
- Filing deadlines
- Supporting documents
- Ownership and follow-up activity
- Overdue and upcoming renewal views

## When teams move from spreadsheets to software

Many teams start with spreadsheets for renewal tracking. That can work early on, but it becomes fragile once deadlines, documents, entities, owners, and locations become harder to review in one place. ExpirationOps is designed for that next step.

- Deadlines live across multiple spreadsheets
- No clear owner is assigned to each item
- Documents are spread across inboxes and folders
- Weekly review takes too much manual work
- Overdue items are easier to miss
- Growth makes the current process harder to manage

## What the pricing is designed to do

The 14-day Pro trial gives you a structured way to start from your current spreadsheet, configure your first workspace, add entities and locations, attach documents, assign owners, and understand how ExpirationOps handles weekly renewal review.

Pro is the main commercial plan. It is designed for ongoing use by businesses managing recurring renewal and deadline workflows across entities, locations, owners, and documents.

Pro is available at $49/month or $490/year billed annually.

ExpirationOps is an internal tracking workspace. It does not provide legal advice, regulatory interpretation, certified audits, or compliance guarantees.

## Pricing FAQ

### Who is ExpirationOps for?

ExpirationOps is designed for multi-location businesses that need a structured way to track licenses, permits, registrations, annual reports, filing deadlines, documents, and related renewal work across entities and locations.

### Is there a free trial?

Yes. ExpirationOps includes a 14-day Pro trial so you can test the renewal tracking workflow with entities, locations, owners, documents, activity history, and weekly review before ongoing paid use.

### What is included on Pro?

Pro is the main commercial plan for real operational use. It includes structured renewal tracking across entities and locations, documents, weekly digest and email reminders, activity history, and team access.

### Is annual billing available?

Yes. Pro is available at $49/month or $490/year billed annually.

### Does ExpirationOps provide legal advice or compliance interpretation?

No. ExpirationOps is an internal tracking workspace. It is for internal tracking and review only.

### When do teams move from spreadsheets to ExpirationOps?

Teams usually move when deadlines, locations, entities, owners, and supporting documents become too difficult to manage across spreadsheets, reminders, and inboxes.
